title: The provider-signals memo is keyed and refilled from the current provider registry, so a long-lived process writes no stale signals under a new key
goal: kbfacts reloads _PROVIDER_ROWS when _registry_key() changes, so a long-lived process (MCP server, hook) whose provider registry or provider code changed after its first pack writes signals of the new registry into the provider_signals memo; pack_freshness_stamp's test is extended with a planted registry change in one process, with no new test id

run: import os, sys; os.environ['KB_INDEX'] = '0'; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kbfacts, provider; cur = {'key': 'A', 'rows': [{'provider': 'x', 'match': 'example.test', 'signals': 'etag;lastmod'}]}; kbfacts._registry_key = lambda: cur['key']; provider.providers = lambda root=None: cur['rows']; kbfacts.provider_signals('https://example.test/a'); cur.update(key='B', rows=[{'provider': 'x', 'match': 'example.test', 'signals': 'version'}]); sys.exit(0 if kbfacts.provider_signals('https://example.test/b') == ['version', 'hash'] else 1)

clauses.clause: kbfacts reloads _PROVIDER_ROWS when _registry_key() changes, so a long-lived process (MCP server, hook) whose provider registry or provider code changed after its first pack writes signals of the new registry into the provider_signals memo
pack_freshness_stamp's test is extended with a planted registry change in one process, with no new test id

notes:
Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 7 of 19, "Freshness at lookup: revalidation on HTTP errors, soft 404s, unreachable hosts and a changed registry"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed.

Premise: after the registry changes in one process, provider_signals still answers with the old rows' signals under the new key. Run 2026-10-12 on the base: reproduces. Registry key A with signals etag;lastmod, then key B with a row giving version: kbfacts.provider_signals answered ['etag', 'lastmod', 'hash'] for the second url (wanted ['version', 'hash']), since _PROVIDER_ROWS is filled once. Check 0 plants that change in one process (no index directory) and fails now. Check 1 names the existing pack_freshness_stamp test with a registry-change suffix: it collects no test now (exit 2); the worker extends that test with the planted change and appends _registry_change to the name's pack_freshness_stamp part, adding no new test id.
